Are you passionate about contemporary design and bringing innovative lighting products to life?

Do you have a technical background and experience developing products from concept to production?

Would you like to join a creative and international team in the heart of Copenhagen?

If yes, please read on!

PRODUCT DEVELOPER – LIGHTING

Based in Copenhagen

At our office in the heart of Copenhagen, you will join our Lighting Product Development team, working closely with talented designers, colleagues across different functions and international manufacturing partners. You will play a key role in transforming creative ideas into high-quality lighting products that combine design, functionality and technical excellence.

About the job

As Product Developer – Lighting at HAY, you will be involved in developing decorative LED lighting products from initial concept to final production. Combining technical development skills with a strong understanding of design, you will work closely with designers, internal teams and international manufacturing partners to bring creative ideas to life.

An important part of your role will be to maintain the original design intent throughout the development process, while ensuring that products meet technical requirements and can be manufactured efficiently. You will help drive projects forward, balancing design, functionality, quality, cost and timelines.

Your daily tasks will include:

• Manage product development projects from initial concept to production, ensuring timelines and key deliverables are met.

• Develop decorative LED lighting solutions, including optics, thermal management, drivers and dimming technologies.

• Create detailed, production-ready 3D models, assemblies and technical drawings using SolidWorks.

• Translate design concepts into technically feasible products, developing and testing prototypes and resolving technical and manufacturing challenges.

• Prepare technical specifications, bills of materials (BOMs) and test documentation.

• Ensure compliance with relevant electrical, safety, sustainability and regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with designers, internal teams and external manufacturing partners throughout the development process.

• Manage project timelines, costs and technical deliverables, supporting suppliers with tooling, pilot production and quality control.

• Format 2D documentation utilizing Microsoft and Adobe Creative Suite packages.

Are you the Product Developer we are looking for?

We are looking for a technically skilled Product Developer who is passionate about contemporary design and has an eye for detail. You understand how to translate creative ideas into functional products without compromising the designer's original vision. You combine technical knowledge with a practical, solution-oriented approach and enjoy working at the intersection of design, engineering and manufacturing. You are comfortable taking responsibility for your projects, keeping track of timelines and collaborating with colleagues and external partners to find the best solutions.

Role expectations

• You are structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

• You enjoy collaborating with designers, colleagues and external partners.

• You are a team player who values collaboration and contributes positively to the HAY culture.

Experience required

• You have a relevant educational background in Product Development, Industrial Design, Engineering or a related field.

• You have experience in technical product development, ideally taking products from concept to production. Experience within decorative lighting is an advantage.

• You have technical knowledge of LED lighting and an understanding of relevant electrical, safety and regulatory requirements.

• You are proficient in SolidWorks, including 3D modeling, assemblies and technical drawings.

• You have experience with prototyping, testing and technical documentation, along with an understanding of materials, manufacturing processes and supplier collaboration.

• You are familiar with Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Suite for preparing and formatting product documentation.

• You communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken, as we are an international company.

You want to be a part of HAY?

Then do not hesitate to send us your application and CV, along with a portfolio showcasing relevant product development projects, as soon as possible and no later than Wednesday 18 November. We evaluate candidates on an ongoing basis.

If you have any further questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact Recruiter, John Cain at john_cain@hermanmiller.com or Senior Manager, Sam Weller at sam.weller@hay.com.

Why join us?

Founded in Copenhagen in 2002 with the ambition of creating contemporary furniture, lighting and accessories for modern living, HAY’s vision is to create high-quality and well-designed products in collaboration with some of the world’s most talented, curious, and courageous designers. Through the commitment to sophisticated industrial manufacturing processes, HAY strives to make good design accessible to the widest possible audience.

Ready to bridge innovation and operations in one of the Nordics' most recognized media brands?

Egmont IT is looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer profile who thrives on improving and automating cloud environments, while understanding the importance of stability, governance, and performance.

You’ll join Egmont’s Cloud Operations team, working primarily with Azure, AWS and partially in GCP. Egmont’s cloud footprint is very large and requires that all engineers think about automation and streamlining first.

Your Role & Impact We are looking for a colleague that is great at asking questions and challenging decisions. We want to build a modern, strong and scalable platform for our many subsidiaries(120+ companies) and we need the right people to do that.

You will be doing hands-on work on our many platforms and solutions to ensure that we constantly improve on new solutions. As well as evaluating old implementations to determine when it is time to modernize.

Responsibilities • Operate and optimize Egmont’s multi-cloud environments

• Automate routine and repetitive tasks and streamline operations.

• Strengthen observability and proactive monitoring in our tools – We use Datadog

• Use Infrastructure as Code to manage changes and enforce standard and detect drift

• Drive modernization initiatives to reduce manual work and promote automation

• Collaborate with developers, security, and infrastructure teams and business stakeholders to ensure stability and compliance

• Contribute ideas, challenge the status quo, and help evolve our culture

What You’ll Bring (Qualifications) We're looking for a blend of technical expertise and a collaborative, proactive mindset.

Desired Skills

• Experience from previous cloud engineering, operations or DevOps roles

• Strong hands-on experience with Azure or AWS (GCP is also a plus)

• Scripting skills in any popular language

• Experience with IaC tools, any apply but we use Terraform

• Good understanding of networking

• Experience working with modern observability tools like Datadog

• Knows how to setup, configure and operate server based infrastructure, running both Linux and Windows

• Working with source control in GitHub or similar providers

• Experience in agentic tooling and a curiosity in following latest trends

Personal Qualities

You can build, automate, and optimize, but you also know that reliability, performance, and security are the foundation of success. You’re curious, pragmatic, and want to be part of a team that’s rethinking how cloud operations are done.

Why Egmont? At Egmont IT, we enable creativity, not just for artist but also in tech. Behind every story, movie, game, or digital experience lies a foundation of stable and secure technology — and that’s where we come in.

Egmont is a foundation, meaning all our profits are reinvested into developing our media companies and donated to support vulnerable children and young people.

You’ll join an international IT organization with a strong purpose and culture. We believe in flexibility, trust, and development. You’ll have freedom to influence our cloud journey, collaborate with talented colleagues across the Nordics and Europe, and grow through certifications and learning opportunities. A key role in a cloud-driven operations team. A workplace that encourages innovation, collaboration, and autonomy. Flexible hybrid work setup (Copenhagen HQ + home office). A chance to make a real difference — We bring stories to life

Ready to join?

Logistics & How to Apply

• Location: Vognmagergade 11, 1120 Copenhagen K, Denmark

• Application deadline: November 14, 2026

• Interviews: Will be scheduled from week 47.

Please send your application as soon as possible — we review applications continuously. Applications are welcome in both Danish and English.

To apply, please use the "Apply Now" button on this page. Note that we do not accept applications via email.

If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact Sabine Lübcke (Senior IT Manager, Cloud & Network) at sabine.lubcke@egmont.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. Being a foundation, all profit is reinvested in our media companies and donated to help improve the lives of vulnerable children and young people and support film talents.

We bring stories to life.

About the Position:

Pleje Trafik ApS is a growing transport and passenger services provider. As our operations expand, we are seeking a dependable Fleet and Logistics Administrator to join our team. In this position, you will work from our office to manage day-to-day administrative tasks, coordinate schedules, and support our active team of drivers.

Key Responsibilities:

• Manage Driver Schedules: Create, update, and manage the weekly work schedules and shift rotations for all company drivers.

• Route Planning & Coordination: Plan and organize daily driving routes to make sure pickups and drop-offs are punctual and efficient.

• Track Booking Platforms: Monitor incoming transport bookings from municipal portals, regional booking systems, and company clients.

• Driver Communication: Act as the main point of contact for drivers on the road, handling daily updates, shift changes, and basic work queries.

• Office Administration: Keep digital records of vehicle logs, maintenance dates, and general operational paperwork.

Qualifications and Skills:

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage timetables and schedules.

• Good communication skills; fluency in English or another secondary language is highly valued.

• Reliable, responsible, and capable of working independently to keep office tasks on track.

• Basic computer skills to manage online booking systems and spreadsheets.

• Previous experience in office work, scheduling, or customer service is a plus but not mandatory.

What We Offer:

• A stable full-time position (37 hours per week).

• A professional office workspace within an established company.

• Salary is negotiable at a professional level, matching the administrative responsibilities of the role.

How to Apply:

Please submit your CV and a brief application letter directly through this portal. Applications are reviewed continuously.

Samsøe Samsøe is looking for a Social Media Lead to shape and drive our global social media presence.

We are looking for a self-driven and experienced profile with a strong understanding of social media, fashion and culture, combined with a great eye for content. You know what makes an image or video work, understand how different platforms behave and can turn ideas into relevant, engaging content.

This is a role with a high level of ownership, combining strategic direction with hands-on content creation. You will work closely with Brand, Creative, Marketing, and E-commerce to ensure Samsøe Samsøe shows up on social in a way that feels distinctive, relevant and true to the brand.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• 
Own and continuously develop the global social media strategy for Samsøe Samsøe.

• 
Lead the planning and execution of the social content calendar across Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest and emerging platforms.

• 
Translate collections, campaigns and brand stories into strong, platform-native social concepts and content.

• 
Create social-first photo and video content independently when relevant, from ideation and shooting through to editing and publishing.

• 
Bring a strong visual perspective to our channels, with a solid understanding of photography, videography, composition, lighting, movement and editing.

• 
Identify opportunities for agile and low-production content alongside larger campaign and brand productions.

• 
Work closely with Creative and Brand teams to develop content while maintaining a strong and consistent visual identity and tone of voice.

• 
Identify cultural moments, conversations, trends and emerging formats relevant to the Samsøe Samsøe universe – and know which ones are right for the brand.

• 
Develop strategies for community growth and engagement, building a relevant and engaged global audience.

• 
Partner with E-commerce and Performance Marketing to support commercial priorities while protecting and strengthening the brand.

• 
Manage content publishing, channel optimisation and ongoing platform development.

• 
Use data and audience insights to understand performance, identify opportunities and continuously improve our approach.

• 
Define and report on relevant social KPIs, translating performance into clear recommendations and actions.

• 
Stay ahead of developments in social media, fashion, culture and digital behaviour and proactively bring new ideas into the organisation.

• 
Manage relevant external partners, creators and agencies when needed.

YOUR PROFILE

You bring a strong combination of social media expertise, creative judgement and hands-on content skills. You understand fashion and visual culture and have a clear sense of what makes content relevant to both a brand and its audience.

You are self-driven and comfortable taking ownership. You spot opportunities, develop ideas and make things happen without needing constant direction. You have the maturity and judgement to make decisions independently while working collaboratively across teams.

We imagine that you:

• 
Have 4+ years of relevant experience in social media and content creation, ideally within fashion, lifestyle or another culturally relevant industry.

• 
Have a strong visual eye and practical photography, videography and editing skills.

• 
Understand social-first storytelling and how to create content specifically for different platforms.

• 
Have a deep understanding of Instagram, TikTok and the wider social landscape.

• 
Combine strategic thinking with the ability and willingness to create and execute yourself.

• 
Have a strong understanding of fashion, brands, culture and emerging creative formats.

• 
Are proactive, resourceful and confident taking an idea from concept to execution.

• 
Are comfortable using data and insights to inform creative and strategic decisions.

• 
Can manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.

• 
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

As our workforce is increasingly more international, our corporate language is English. If you can identify with our concept and our ambitions, we look forward to receiving your application.

We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and encourage everyone to apply for the position, regardless of age, national and cultural background, gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

jobs.occupation: Tour guides for Copenhagen - Part time freelance
jobs.description:
Tour Guide – Copenhagen

Part-time freelance | Small Groups

Do people describe you as a storyteller? Are you the friend who always ends up explaining the history, recommending the hidden café, or connecting the dots? Do you love Copenhagen — not just the postcard version, but the layers beneath it?

Then keep reading.

About Amitylux

Amitylux is a multi-award-winning boutique travel company creating high-touch, personal guided experiences across the Nordics and the UK. We focus on small groups, meaningful conversations, and experiences that feel natural rather than scripted. Our tours are relaxed, human, and built around connection. We value calm, confident leadership. We value thoughtful storytelling that adapts to the group. We value presence, awareness, and reading the room. Our guests come from all over the world — from curious leisure travellers to corporate and VIP groups. What they all appreciate is authenticity, quality, and a genuine sense of welcome rather than being processed.

You Might Be a Great Fit If You:

• 
Can turn strangers into friends within a few hours

• 
Feel comfortable leading while staying warm and approachable

• 
Have lived in Copenhagen long enough to truly understand it

• 
Plan to stay and grow here

• 
Speak fluent English (additional languages are a strong plus)

• 
Enjoy walking, biking, and being outdoors

• 
Understand that guiding is both performance and hospitality

This is not about memorising dates. It’s about creating a feeling people remember.

What You’ll Experience With Us

• 
A supportive, high-standard team culture

• 
Autonomy and trust

• 
The chance to meet people from around the world

• 
The opportunity to grow your leadership and storytelling skills

• 
Being part of a brand that cares deeply about guest experience

We take pride in what we do — and we look for people who feel the same.

Join us on this journey — and help shape meaningful travel experiences in Copenhagen. 

Application

We review candidates continuously and close once we find the right match.

Please note: Applications are only accepted via our hiring platform on The Hub. We are unable to review applications sent by email or other channels.

Important: Your application must include a short personal video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a great fit for Amitylux. Applications without a video will not be considered.

(The Hub allows you to record directly. Pre-recorded files can be added as a link or file.)

jobs.description:
The Science Hub Denmark initiative is expanding. Join us and help us tell the world why Denmark is a fantastic place to pursue a career in research!

We are looking for a promising Student Assistant with a passion for science to join our growing team that aims to brand Denmark internationally as an attractive career destination for elite researchers within Biosolutions, Biomedicine, Neuroscience, Sustainable Energy Tech, Quantum and AI.

We are still looking for a new setup for the team and are therefore open to profiles within all our focus areas.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• 
Assist the Science Hub team in running the project and developing and executing the various activities and events. Both online and in-person. This could imply some international travel.

• 
Conduct market research.

• 
 Candidate and university outreach.

• 
Provide administrative support to the team.

• 
 Work with our CRM system, HubSpot.

Your profileYou are currently studying a master’s degree and are excited about the opportunity to share with the world why Denmark is a great place to live and work. You are a motivated, creative and a structured team player. It would be good if you have some of the skills and competencies listed below but don’t worry if you don’t have them all. If you have the right mindset, everything is possible!

• 
A passion for science and an interest and firsthand knowledge of one of our research areas at Danish universities.

• 
Proficient in English both verbally and in writing.

• 
Outgoing with good communication and public speaking skills

• 
Good organisational and time management skills.

• 
Ability to work effectively within a team and independently.

Our offices are in the city center of Copenhagen, Denmark. You’ll work here part-time: 15-20 hours per week. We’ll agree on a work schedule that fits with your studies.Copenhagen Capacity Copenhagen Capacity is Greater Copenhagen’s organization for investment promotion and regionaleconomic development. We work to make the region even more attractive to foreign investment andmarket it internationally to attract companies, investors, and highly educated workers.

The goal is to create jobs, growth, and development in Greater Copenhagen. In addition to that, we are a close-knit, passionate organization with a multinational work environment where English is our shared office language. We value collaboration and connection, whether over lunch in the company canteen with colleagues across departments or at social events.

Science Hub Denmark Science Hub Denmark is an initiative dedicated to enhancing the international visibility of Danish research and career opportunities in Denmark. With funding from Villum Fonden, Novo Nordisk Fonden, and Lundbeck Fonden, the initiative will continue for three more years with the aim of significantly increasing the interest in Danish research worldwide, while also exploring innovative strategies for promoting career opportunities in Denmark. 

Emphasizing research excellence, societal impact, and quality of life, the initiative will utilize digital channels to engage researchers abroad and facilitate recruitment for research positions at Danish universities. The project focuses on key areas: Biosolutions, Biomedicine, Neuroscience, Sustainable Energy Tech, Quantum and AI; research strongholds where Denmark excels internationally. 

How to apply If you think you’re the right profile for this position and our team, please apply before the 8th of November 2026 by sending your CV and cover letter job@copcap.com with "Student Assistant – Science Hub" in the subject line.  Interviews are expected to be held in the week of 9-13 November.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please reach out to Head of Science Hub Denmark – Alexander Watts, by email: alw@copcap.com
